_about: Evelyn Shirley Shuckburgh (1843-1906). Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): Augustus: the Life and Times of the Founder of the Roman Empire, clean Gutenberg. His translations (Polybius, Cicero's letters) are on those shelves. Round dt (2026-10-23), raw IA: his histories (A History of Rome to the Battle of Actium, 1894; A History of Rome for Beginners, 1897; Greece from the Coming of the Hellenes, 1906) and his school and college editions with English commentary (Suetonius's Divus Augustus, 1896; Lysias XVI, 1882; Herodotus VIII and IX, 1887; Horace's Epistles I, 1888; Terence's Hauton Timorumenos with his translation, 1877); the Latin and Greek text editions are kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. No uids minted.
